learnings: When a model encounters API errors on critical files (PKGBUILD, .install), the audit tool should either retry the request or escalate to a different model rather than marking the entire audit inconclusive

For binary packages (-bin), models should explicitly verify that source URLs point to the legitimate upstream release page and that checksums are present for all architecture-specific binaries
